mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies near Fireman's Park with a temperature of 66 degrees. We have a waxing crescent moon, and the ISS will be visible at 5:35 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward Fitchburg and Madison, appearing almost directly overhead.

The City of Verona recently approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates. These utilities are self-supporting, and the increase ensures we can maintain essential infrastructure like retention ponds and street cleaning to avoid flooding or system failures. Also, congratulations to the four students who won the I Voted sticker contest; their art will be at our polling places this November.

We have plenty going on in town. Today, Epic Systems is hosting their User Group Meeting, and you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or join in on Wednesday Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
Regarding the weekly police report, on Saturday, August 15, officers responded to a reckless driver report. The driver, a 29-year-old Verona man, was arrested for his second O W I offence.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Chocolate Pecan. The store is currently closed but will reopen at 10 AM, so be sure to stop by once they open their doors.
